Folder for the THINGS images (Hebart et al., 2019; EXTERNAL_INPUTS.md, M7; optional). Download
images_THINGS.zip from osf.io/jum2f (5.0 GB; the password comes with the license agreement, which allows
research and educational use only and no redistribution) and unzip it so that
external/things_images/<concept>/<file>.jpg exists.

No reported number needs the images. Module 03 draws them as thumbnails in Fig. 3e when they are here,
and shared/embedding_extraction/ extracts the THINGS embeddings from them. A Fig. 3e drawn with the
thumbnails contains THINGS photographs, so do not redistribute it.
